baseline.workingTree: Contains prior installed, uncommitted implementation; HEAD alone is not the baseline

existing: prediction-loop/round-input/design-guidance own selection and final model input
evidence-manager and existing trace/eval records own returned/exposed evidence
Canonical guidance documents, evidence_packet_contract, generated guidance and preset already exist
ue-accuracy fixture/runner own versioned evaluation; partialSearchScopeNotice owns the post-answer scope notice
proposed: Correlate loaded identity, guidance delivery, source acquisition and source retention before attributing accuracy failure
Preserve bounded representative claim locations in grouped validation diagnostics
Consolidate existing evidence/absence/severity/retraction guidance only where needed
Reuse existing evaluation owners for consumer, replication, prediction and structural repair cases
Compare preserved working-tree baseline with candidate and retain actual GUI adoption checks
doNotDuplicate: No new semantic truth judge, forced search/answer gate, state database or benchmark runner
Do not reimplement installed output, read-window, identity, permission/hash/receipt or prefix fixes
Do not hard-code the user's function names or expected labels into model guidance
invariants: Preserve pre-existing dirty worktree and user's game checkout
Keep bounded validation response size and structural-only truth scope
Do not treat partial broad searches as evidence of symbol absence
Preserve true defect detection; all-ambiguous responses cannot pass
Keep 5.7.4 real-project and 5.8.2 evaluation evidence separate
impactedSurfaces: MCP validation result/errors and existing tests
Canonical guidance, preset, generated source and runtime identity
Evaluation fixtures, tool adapters, source hashes and human-reviewed scoring
validationPlan: Detailed phases, gates and supported commands are in docs/Opus_Audit_Accuracy_Handoff_20261020.md
Focused diagnostic and input tests precede full affected suites
Small baseline/candidate smoke precedes three paired repetitions of full and held-out evaluation
Measure source/citation accuracy separately from labels and latency separately from generation rate
Actual GUI loading and adopted installation remain separate verification steps
